posts.text: I’m building out FY27-FY28 estimates based on the screen expansion guidance shared and wanted to confirm a few numbers before I finalize my model: Assumptions I’m working with: Current operational screens: 120 Total contracted pipeline: 250 screens New screens FY27: 80 | FY28: 170 EPC revenue: ₹1.3 cr/new screen (one-time) EPC EBITDA margin: 30% Royalty: ₹10 lakh/operational screen/year VPF profit: ₹5 lakh/operational screen/year This implies: FY27: EPC revenue ₹104 cr, EPC EBITDA ₹31.2 cr, 200 total screens, royalty run-rate ₹20 cr, VPF run-rate ₹10 cr FY28: EPC revenue ₹221 cr, EPC EBITDA ₹6…
